name: Invarune skill and tool instruction evidence corpus
provenance: Project-authored synthetic cases, including paired safe examples, obfuscation and explicit unsupported challenges. Labels derive from stated instruction semantics, not detector output. This is not independent validation or a production prevalence sample. Revision 1.1 changes exactly one label: agent-visible JSON tool input-schema descriptions are instruction surfaces. The legacy 1.0 bytes and their raw scores are preserved separately; sources and case IDs are unchanged.
metric_unit: One explicit rule-presence assertion per case/rule; these labels establish risk-pattern evidence, not malicious author intent or confirmed exploitation.
